;; Public
(define-public (swap-xs
	(adapter-trait-a <xyk-adapter-trait>) (pool-trait-a <xyk-pool-trait>) (adapter-trait-b <stableswap-adapter-trait>) (pool-trait-b <stableswap-pool-trait>) (x-for-y-a bool) (x-for-y-b bool) (is-stx-in bool) (is-stx-mid-a bool) (is-stx-out bool) (token-in-trait <sip-010-trait>) (token-mid-a-out-trait <sip-010-trait>) (token-mid-a-in-trait <sip-010-trait>) (token-out-trait <sip-010-trait>) (amount uint) (min-received-mid-a uint) (min-received uint) (deadline uint) (agg-fee-amount uint) (agg-fee-max uint) (recipient principal) (provider (optional principal)))
	(begin
		(try! (check-route-preconditions deadline agg-fee-amount agg-fee-max))
		(try! (check-non-zero amount))
		(try! (check-mid-token-match is-stx-mid-a token-mid-a-out-trait token-mid-a-in-trait))
		(let ((sb (stx-get-balance current-contract)))
			(try! (transfer-in-exact is-stx-in token-in-trait amount))
			(let (( m1 (try! (swap-xyk-adapter adapter-trait-a pool-trait-a x-for-y-a is-stx-in is-stx-mid-a token-in-trait token-mid-a-out-trait amount min-received-mid-a) )))
				(let (( gross (try! (swap-stableswap-adapter adapter-trait-b pool-trait-b x-for-y-b is-stx-mid-a is-stx-out token-mid-a-in-trait token-out-trait m1 u0) )))
					(let ((amount-out (try! (settle-output token-out-trait is-stx-out gross agg-fee-amount min-received recipient sb))))
						(print {
							action: "swap-xs",
							caller: tx-sender,
							data: {
								amount: amount,
								min-received: min-received,
								amount-out: amount-out,
								agg-fee-amount: agg-fee-amount,
								agg-fee-max: agg-fee-max,
								recipient: recipient,
								provider: provider
							}
						})
						(ok amount-out)))))))

;; Private
(define-private (check-deadline (d uint)) (begin (asserts! (>= d stacks-block-height) ERR_DEADLINE_PASSED) (ok true)))

(define-private (check-agg-fee-bounds (s uint) (m uint)) (begin (asserts! (<= s m) ERR_AGG_FEE_OVER_MAX) (ok true)))

(define-private (check-non-zero (n uint)) (begin (asserts! (> n u0) ERR_ZERO_AMOUNT) (ok true)))

(define-private (check-route-preconditions (d uint) (s uint) (m uint)) (begin (try! (check-deadline d)) (try! (check-agg-fee-bounds s m)) (ok true)))

(define-private (transfer-in (si bool) (ti <sip-010-trait>) (a uint)) (if si (stx-transfer? a tx-sender current-contract) (contract-call? ti transfer a tx-sender current-contract none)))

(define-private (asset-balance (s bool) (t <sip-010-trait>) (p principal)) (if s (ok (stx-get-balance p)) (contract-call? t get-balance p)))

(define-private (router-balance (s bool) (t <sip-010-trait>)) (asset-balance s t current-contract))

(define-private (transfer-in-exact (si bool) (ti <sip-010-trait>) (a uint)) (let ((rb (try! (asset-balance si ti current-contract))) (sb (try! (asset-balance si ti tx-sender)))) (try! (transfer-in si ti a)) (asserts! (is-eq (try! (asset-balance si ti current-contract)) (+ rb a)) ERR_INPUT_DELIVERY) (asserts! (is-eq (+ (try! (asset-balance si ti tx-sender)) a) sb) ERR_INPUT_OUTFLOW) (ok true)))

(define-private (transfer-from-router (so bool) (t <sip-010-trait>) (a uint) (r principal)) (if so (as-contract? ((with-stx a)) (try! (stx-transfer? a tx-sender r))) (as-contract? ((with-ft (contract-of t) "*" a)) (try! (contract-call? t transfer a tx-sender r none)))))

(define-private (transfer-exact (so bool) (t <sip-010-trait>) (a uint) (r principal)) (if (is-eq a u0) (ok true) (let ((rb (try! (asset-balance so t current-contract))) (db (try! (asset-balance so t r)))) (try! (transfer-from-router so t a r)) (asserts! (is-eq (try! (asset-balance so t r)) (+ db a)) ERR_DELIVERY_MISMATCH) (asserts! (is-eq (+ (try! (asset-balance so t current-contract)) a) rb) ERR_ROUTER_OUTFLOW) (ok true))))

(define-private (check-swap-invariants (si bool) (so bool) (ti <sip-010-trait>) (to <sip-010-trait>)) (begin (asserts! (not (and si so)) ERR_STX_BOTH_SIDES) (asserts! (or si so (not (is-eq (contract-of ti) (contract-of to)))) ERR_SAME_TOKEN) (ok true)))

(define-private (check-mid-token-match (sm bool) (mo <sip-010-trait>) (mi <sip-010-trait>)) (begin (asserts! (or sm (is-eq (contract-of mo) (contract-of mi))) ERR_SPLIT_OUTPUT_MISMATCH) (ok true)))

(define-private (settle-output (to <sip-010-trait>) (so bool) (g uint) (s uint) (mo uint) (r principal) (sb uint)) (begin (asserts! (>= g s) ERR_AGG_FEE_OVER_GROSS) (let ((n (- g s))) (asserts! (>= n mo) ERR_MINIMUM_RECEIVED) (try! (transfer-exact so to s TREASURY)) (try! (transfer-exact so to n r)) (asserts! (is-eq (stx-get-balance current-contract) sb) ERR_STX_FLOAT) (ok n))))

(define-private (swap-generic-adapter (ad <generic-adapter-trait>) (pid uint) (xy bool) (si bool) (so bool) (ti <sip-010-trait>) (to <sip-010-trait>) (ai uint) (ml uint)) (begin (try! (check-swap-invariants si so ti to)) (let ((b (try! (router-balance so to)))) (try! (if si (as-contract? ((with-stx ai)) (try! (contract-call? ad swap-leg pid xy si so ti to ai ml))) (as-contract? ((with-ft (contract-of ti) "*" ai)) (try! (contract-call? ad swap-leg pid xy si so ti to ai ml))))) (let ((g (- (try! (router-balance so to)) b))) (asserts! (>= g ml) ERR_MINIMUM_RECEIVED) (ok g)))))

(define-private (swap-stableswap-adapter (ad <stableswap-adapter-trait>) (p <stableswap-pool-trait>) (xy bool) (si bool) (so bool) (ti <sip-010-trait>) (to <sip-010-trait>) (ai uint) (ml uint)) (begin (try! (check-swap-invariants si so ti to)) (let ((b (try! (router-balance so to)))) (try! (if si (as-contract? ((with-stx ai)) (try! (contract-call? ad swap-leg p xy si so ti to ai ml))) (as-contract? ((with-ft (contract-of ti) "*" ai)) (try! (contract-call? ad swap-leg p xy si so ti to ai ml))))) (let ((g (- (try! (router-balance so to)) b))) (asserts! (>= g ml) ERR_MINIMUM_RECEIVED) (ok g)))))

(define-private (swap-xyk-adapter (ad <xyk-adapter-trait>) (p <xyk-pool-trait>) (xy bool) (si bool) (so bool) (ti <sip-010-trait>) (to <sip-010-trait>) (ai uint) (ml uint)) (begin (try! (check-swap-invariants si so ti to)) (let ((b (try! (router-balance so to)))) (try! (if si (as-contract? ((with-stx ai)) (try! (contract-call? ad swap-leg p xy si so ti to ai ml))) (as-contract? ((with-ft (contract-of ti) "*" ai)) (try! (contract-call? ad swap-leg p xy si so ti to ai ml))))) (let ((g (- (try! (router-balance so to)) b))) (asserts! (>= g ml) ERR_MINIMUM_RECEIVED) (ok g)))))
